For this month's RUG, Raimundo Sanchez will demonstrate **how to use R and geospatial techniques to analyze GPS data from endurance athletes**.

Raimundo is a researcher with a PhD in complex systems engineering, specialising in studying human movement in free living conditions.

We will follow with our usual drop-in, collaborative session.
